entities.summary: Paul N. van den Broeck was a Belgian bobsledder and ice hockey player who competed during the early 1920s. At the 1924 Winter Olympics in Chamonix he won a bronze medal in the four-man bobsleigh event. He was also a member of the Belgian ice hockey team which was eliminated in the first round of the 1924 Olympic tournament.
